prompt: Picking a rhetorical "shape" (template) for a bot's next post from a library of 30 shapes:

options.label: Random selection
options.content: Pull one shape at random from all 30, every time. No infrastructure needed beyond a list. Over many posts, this keeps things varied and occasionally surprising - the bot might land on a shape that isn't the most obviously fitting one, which can itself read as more distinctive and less predictable than always picking the "correct" choice.

options.label: RAG retrieval
options.content: Embed the current situation, search the shape library, and use whichever shape scores closest semantically. Requires embeddings and a vector search step to set up. Over many posts with similar situations, this tends to keep reaching for the same handful of best-fitting shapes - more relevant on any single post, but noticeably more repetitive across many of them.
